properties.name: name
properties.description: Object identifier. Pass it to altdss.LineGeometry.new or use it after LineGeometry. in a DSS New command.

properties.name: nconds
properties.description: Count of physical conductors. Set a positive count before assigning positions or conductors. Assigning NConds initializes the coordinate slots and clears conductor references.

properties.name: nphases
properties.description: Count of retained phase conductors. Set it explicitly for the model after NConds. List the phase conductors before any additional neutrals.

properties.name: wires
properties.description: Ordered sequence of WireData, CNData, or TSData references. Supply one reference per slots allocated by NConds when using the Python Conductors keyword. The matching DSS engine row is Wires.

properties.name: x
properties.description: Horizontal positions in conductor order. Positions are initially empty until conductor slots are allocated. Applying Spacing replaces these positions.

properties.name: h
properties.description: Vertical positions in conductor order. Positions are initially empty until conductor slots are allocated. Applying Spacing replaces these positions.

properties.name: units
properties.description: Length unit for X and H. The engine stores units per conductor and has a sticky feet preference for unassigned slots. Assigning Spacing copies its unit to every slot. The pinned Python scalar enum getter can raise ValueError on this array-backed field, so use the configured spacing or DSS conductor entries as the unit record.

properties.name: normamps
properties.description: Initial normal ampacity in amperes. Assigning conductor data can set the rating from the first conductor.

properties.name: emergamps
properties.description: Initial emergency ampacity in amperes. Assigning conductor data can set the rating from the first conductor.

properties.name: reduce
properties.description: Enable Kron reduction of additional conductors to NPhases when geometry constants are computed. Order phase conductors before neutrals.

properties.name: spacing
properties.description: Reference to a previously defined LineSpacing with the same NConds. Assigning it copies X, H, and units into the geometry.

properties.name: seasons
properties.description: Initial number of seasonal ratings.

properties.name: ratings
properties.description: Ampacity ratings in amperes. Initially contains the constructor's normal ampacity of 0 A. Supply rated values for a usable design.

properties.name: linetype
properties.description: Line type code. The engine initializes the enum to OH.

properties.name: like
properties.description: DSS creation keyword and Python action that copies another LineGeometry definition. There is no readable property value.

properties.name: x
properties.description: Horizontal coordinates in Units. Provide one value per conductor position.

properties.name: h
properties.description: Vertical coordinates in Units. Provide one value per conductor position.

properties.name: units
properties.description: Length unit for both coordinate arrays. Set it after NConds because that assignment resets it to ft.

Required properties describe the object identifier. Conditional entries describe useful model inputs or a declared engine specification set.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Object identifier. Pass it to altdss.WireData.new or use it after WireData. in a DSS New command.

properties.name: rdc
properties.description: DC resistance in ohms per RUnits. If RAC is unset, setting RDC initializes RAC to 1.02 times RDC in the pinned engine.

properties.name: rac
properties.description: AC resistance at 60 Hz in ohms per RUnits. If RDC is unset, setting RAC initializes RDC to RAC divided by 1.02 in the pinned engine.

properties.name: runits
properties.description: Length unit in the denominator of conductor resistance. For CNData this unit also applies to RStrand.

properties.name: gmrac
properties.description: Geometric mean radius at 60 Hz in GMRUnits. A radius or diameter update supplies 0.7788 times radius when GMRAC is unset. Setting GMRAC can derive an unset radius.

properties.name: gmrunits
properties.description: Length unit for GMRAC and CNData.GMRStrand. Assign it explicitly because setting it can fill an unset RadUnits.

properties.name: radius
properties.description: Conductor outside radius in RadUnits. If unset, setting GMRAC derives Radius as GMRAC divided by 0.7788.

properties.name: radunits
properties.description: Length unit for radius, diameter, and physical cable dimensions. Setting it can fill an unset GMRUnits.

properties.name: normamps
properties.description: Normal ampacity in amperes. If unset when EmergAmps is assigned, the engine derives NormAmps as EmergAmps divided by 1.5.

properties.name: emergamps
properties.description: Emergency ampacity in amperes. If unset when NormAmps is assigned, the engine derives EmergAmps as 1.5 times NormAmps.

properties.name: diam
properties.description: Alternative input for conductor diameter in RadUnits. The engine stores half the assigned diameter in Radius.

properties.name: seasons
properties.description: Number of seasonal ampacity ratings. Assigning this field resizes the ratings array.

properties.name: ratings
properties.description: Seasonal ampacity values in amperes. The constructor initializes a one-entry array from the unset normal ampacity sentinel. Supply actual ratings before using seasonal ratings.

properties.name: capradius
properties.description: Effective conductor radius for capacitance in RadUnits. Assigning Radius or Diam initializes CapRadius to Radius when it was unset.

properties.name: like
properties.description: DSS creation keyword and Python action that copies another WireData definition. There is no readable property value.
